basic_details.job_title: RRB Isolated Categories Recruitment 2026 CEN 09/2026 (Short Notice) – Apply Online for 195 Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), Ministry of Railways, Government of India
basic_details.short_information: The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have issued CEN No. 09/2026 as an indicative notice to keep prospective candidates informed about the forthcoming detailed CEN. The notice also helps candidates get ready with the certificates and documents required for applying. Register for Job Alerts

application_fee.details: The application fee, category-wise fee details and the payment mode are not specified in the indicative notice. These details are expected in the detailed CEN No. 09/2026.

age_limit.details: The age limit is listed as "As per Detailed CEN", with the age to be counted as on 01.01.2027. Minimum and maximum age limits and age relaxation details are not specified in the indicative notice.

qualification.details: The educational qualification and other eligibility criteria are not specified in the indicative notice. The notice states that all terms, conditions, eligibility criteria, procedures and other requirements will be strictly as per the detailed CEN No. 09/2026, along with any corrigendum that may be issued from time to time. | The medical standard is also listed as "As per Detailed CEN".

salary_details.details: The notice mentions the pay level as per the 7th CPC as Level 2 and Level 7. The actual pay amount, allowances and post-wise pay level mapping are not specified in the indicative notice.

selection_process: The selection stages are not specified in the indicative notice. The notice refers to "detailed scrutiny at every stage of recruitment process" for Non-Aadhaar Verified applications
but it does not list the stages themselves. Candidates should wait for the detailed CEN No. 09/2026 for the selection process.
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted through online mode only. The detailed application procedure is not given in the indicative notice. Based on the information available, candidates can prepare as follows:
Visit the common website of all RRBs, https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in, and look for the detailed CEN No. 09/2026.
Check that the Name and Date of Birth in Aadhaar match 100% with the 10th class pass certificate, and that Aadhaar has the latest photo and biometrics (Fingerprint and Iris).
Keep the necessary certificates and documents ready, as advised in the notice.
Read the eligibility criteria, procedures and other requirements in the detailed CEN once it is published.
Submit the complete online application between the tentative opening date (05.11.2026) and closing date (04.12.2026, 23:59 hours).

The RRB Isolated Categories apply online window is tentatively scheduled from 05.11.2026 to 04.12.2026 (23:59 hours). A direct application link is not provided in the indicative notice. Candidates should use the official RRB website and confirm the dates in the detailed CEN.
important_instructions: The notice carries the following notes for candidates:

Candidates are advised to verify their primary details using Aadhaar while filling the online application. This helps avoid inconvenience and delays caused by detailed scrutiny at every stage of the recruitment process for Non-Aadhaar Verified applications. For successful Aadhaar verification, the Name and Date of Birth in Aadhaar must be updated to match 100% with the Full Name and Date of Birth in the 10th class pass certificate. Aadhaar also needs to be updated with the latest photo and latest biometrics (Fingerprint and Iris) before filling the online application. The notice is purely indicative in nature. It is issued only to keep prospective candidates informed about the forthcoming detailed CEN and to help them be ready with the necessary certificates or documents required for applying. All terms, conditions, eligibility criteria, procedures and other requirements will be strictly as per the detailed CEN No. 09/2026 (along with any corrigendum issued from time to time). It will be published exclusively on the common website of all RRBs, https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in. Candidates can navigate to the webpages of individual RRBs from this common website.
The notice also carries a caution: "Beware of touts, brokers and job racketeers."

faq.question: Q1. What is RRB Isolated Categories Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment by the Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), Ministry of Railways, for various posts of Isolated Categories under CEN No. 09/2026. The notice issued is an indicative notice.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced under RRB CEN No. 09/2026?
faq.answer: A total of 195 vacancies have been announced for various posts of isolated categories in this recruitment notification released by the Railway Recruitment Boards.

faq.question: Q3. When does the online application process start for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The online application process for RRB Various Posts of Isolated Categories Recruitment 2026 officially begins on 5 November 2026 for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can submit their completed online applications until the closing date of 4 December 2026. Make sure to apply well before the deadline to avoid technical issues.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for RRB Isolated Categories posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively through the online mode via the official RRB websites. Offline or physical applications are not accepted under any circumstances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for the notified isolated category posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be placed in Level 2 and Level 7 according to the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) structure depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q7. Is Aadhaar verification mandatory during the application process?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates are advised and required to verify their primary personal details using Aadhaar during the online application process as per the instructions.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required while filling out the online application?
faq.answer: Applicants need to upload their latest photograph and provide latest biometrics including fingerprint and iris scans as part of the digital application procedure.

faq.question: Q9. Is this notification a detailed advertisement or an indicative notice?
faq.answer: This notice is purely indicative in nature, issued solely for the purpose of keeping prospective candidates informed about the forthcoming detailed CEN.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to apply for these vacancies?
faq.answer: You can access the official Railway Recruitment Boards portal at https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in to review updates and complete your online registration safely.
